brief_summary: The aim of this trial is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of HRS-7535 in subjects with type 2 diabetes mellitus.
brief_title: A 16 Week Study of HRS-7535 in Adults With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
official_title: A 16-week Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blinded, Placebo-controlled, Parallel-group Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of HRS-7535 in Adults With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus Inadequately Controlled on Metformin

primary_outcomes.measure: Mean Change From Baseline in HbA1c at Week 16
